**The Team**
Enterprise Solutions (ES) Technology brings together data, software, services, and expertise to deliver innovative solutions for global financial markets. The team works closely with customers to help them manage complex business, regulatory, and risk requirements.
  
  
Financial Risk Analytics (FRA), part of Enterprise Solutions, delivers information-centric capital markets and risk solutions for trading desks and their risk-management partners. Its products support counterparty credit risk, xVA, and market risk for both buy-side and sell-side institutions.
  
  
We are seeking a Lead Quality Engineer to join the FRA Technology team. As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will own and influence the quality strategy across the software delivery lifecycle—from requirements and solution design through development, release, and production support. title: Senior AI Test Engineer
description:
Senior AI Test Engineer

**Location:**
Remote

About the Role

Alternative Path is looking for a
**Senior AI Test Engineer**
to lead quality assurance on a client engagement with a leading financial data and analytics company that has built AI agent systems (chatbots, RAG-based research/report generation, MCP-based tool-calling agents) on top of its proprietary datasets for its own clients. This is a senior, client-facing role: you'll own the test strategy for these systems end-to-end, working directly with the client's engineering team to validate accuracy, reliability, and safety before these agents reach financial industry end-users — where hallucinations or bad data retrieval carry real business risk.

This is not conventional QA. You'll be building evaluation frameworks and datasets, running systematic evals, and defining quality bars for non-deterministic, LLM-driven systems operating over complex financial data.

**About Alternative Path**

Alternative Path is a strategic operations consulting firm, founded in 2020, that helps growth-stage and enterprise organizations build high-performing, India-based teams across Technology Ops, Data Ops, Business Intelligence, and Finance. Every engagement is senior-led, and the firm has delivered 50+ engagements for clients across the US, Europe, and Australia.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the
  **test and evaluation strategy**
  for the client's AI agent systems — chatbots, RAG-based research/report generation, and MCP-based tool-calling agents
* Design and build
  **eval suites**
  covering accuracy, groundedness/faithfulness to source data, task completion, latency, and safety
* Build and curate
  **golden datasets**
  reflecting real client use cases and financial-data edge cases (ambiguous queries, stale data, conflicting sources, numerical precision)
* Use eval/observability tooling such as
  **LangSmith**
  (or equivalents — Ragas, DeepEval, Braintrust, Langfuse, PromptFoo) to trace, score, and monitor agent runs
* Define and track RAG-specific metrics (retrieval precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation/source accuracy) — critical given the systems sit on top of financial datasets where correctness is non-negotiable
* Evaluate MCP-based tool-calling behavior — correct tool selection, multi-step task execution, failure handling
* Design regression testing so prompt, model, or data-pipeline changes don't silently degrade quality
* Run structured red-teaming for hallucinations, prompt injection, and unsafe/incorrect financial outputs
* Act as the primary quality point of contact with the client's engineering stakeholders — translating findings into clear, actionable risk assessments
* Mentor/guide any junior QA resources staffed onto the engagement as it scales
* Build automation to integrate evals into CI pipelines where feasible

What We're Looking For

**Must-haves**

* **3+ years**
  in software QA/testing, with
  **hands-on senior-level experience evaluating LLM-based or agentic AI systems**
  (not just traditional QA)
* Direct experience with
  **eval frameworks/tools**
  — LangSmith strongly preferred; also acceptable: Ragas, DeepEval, PromptFoo, Braintrust, Langfuse
* Strong understanding of
  **RAG architecture**
  and how to independently evaluate retrieval quality vs. generation quality
* Practical familiarity with
  **MCP (Model Context Protocol)**
  or comparable agent tool-calling frameworks
* Strong Python skills for building test harnesses, scoring pipelines, and automation
* Experience designing evaluation approaches for
  **non-deterministic**
  systems (probabilistic scoring, not binary pass/fail)
* Comfortable working
  **directly with client engineering teams**
  — strong communication, able to explain quality risk to both technical and business stakeholders
* Prior experience in a
  **client services / consulting QA environment**
  (this is a client-facing engagement, not an internal product team)

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience testing AI systems in
  **fintech, capital markets, or data/analytics**
  domains
* Familiarity with financial data accuracy/compliance considerations (numerical precision, source traceability, audit trails)
* Exposure to LLM red-teaming/safety evaluation practices
* Experience with browser-automation agent testing (Playwright or similar)

description:
**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s most trusted Muslim Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. With
**65,000+ success storie**
s and

, we are committed to fostering strong connections and building a better community. Our AI-based algorithm ensures seamless profile searches and connections, transforming the way people approach marriage. Based in India, NikahForever has created a user-friendly platform where finding your life partner happens in just three steps: Register, Search, and Connect.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an engineer who can
**think independently, solve difficult problems, and turn ideas into reliable production software.**

You won't always get a detailed specification or a step-by-step implementation plan. You'll get a problem, its context, and the freedom to figure out how to solve it. You'll learn unfamiliar systems, make practical engineering decisions, build and test solutions, and take ownership of your work from implementation through deployment.

We're AI-native. You'll use AI coding agents and modern engineering tools to accelerate development, explore unfamiliar codebases, debug issues, and automate repetitive work. You'll remain accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of everything you ship.

We don't hire based on familiarity with a particular programming language, framework, or technology stack.
**We value strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, learning speed, engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver working software.**

**What You'll Do**

* **Build and ship software:**
  Turn product requirements and business problems into working, reliable software that delivers measurable value.
* **Own features end to end:**
  Understand requirements, explore possible solutions, implement features, write tests, deploy changes, and fix issues after release.
* **Solve engineering problems:**
  Break down ambiguous problems, evaluate trade-offs, reason through edge cases, and develop practical solutions without relying on step-by-step instructions.
* **Work across domains:**
  Contribute to backend systems, APIs, databases, infrastructure, integrations, data-intensive applications, and AI-powered workflows as the problem requires.
* **Navigate unfamiliar systems:**
  Understand existing codebases, investigate how components interact, and adapt to new technologies without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* **Debug and investigate:**
  Reproduce failures, analyze logs and system behavior, identify root causes, and implement fixes that prevent recurring problems.
* **Make sound technical decisions:**
  Consider correctness, performance, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and implementation complexity when choosing a solution.
* **Use AI-native engineering workflows:**
  Leverage AI coding agents for exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring. Review their output critically and verify that solutions work as intended.
* **Automate repetitive work:**
  Identify inefficient manual processes and build tools or automations that improve productivity and reduce operational effort.
* **Collaborate and take ownership:**
  Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and technical problem-solving. Communicate blockers early and incorporate feedback constructively.
* **Continuously improve:**
  Learn from production issues, measure the impact of your work, and improve the quality and reliability of the systems you build.

**Examples of Problems You'll Tackle**

* Build a new product capability from an ambiguous requirement, making appropriate implementation and design decisions along the way.
* Investigate a slow or unreliable service, identify its bottlenecks, and improve its performance and resilience.
* Design a reliable workflow for processing tasks asynchronously, handling failures, and preventing data inconsistencies.
* Build an AI-powered workflow that uses external tools and APIs to automate a multi-step business process.
* Investigate a production failure in an unfamiliar codebase, identify the root cause, and ship a thoroughly tested fix.
* Develop an internal tool that removes repetitive manual work and measure the resulting improvement in efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have**

* Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to reason systematically about unfamiliar problems.
* A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and essential software design principles.
* The ability to write clear, maintainable, and testable code, regardless of the programming language or technology used.
* A practical understanding of how software components interact, including APIs, databases, networking, and operating systems.
* The ability to break down complex tasks into smaller, verifiable steps and make progress without constant supervision.
* Comfort navigating unfamiliar codebases, learning new technologies, and adapting to different technical environments.
* A disciplined approach to debugging, testing, handling edge cases, and investigating the root causes of failures.
* The judgment to make reasonable technical trade-offs and recognize when a solution is unnecessarily complex or unreliable.
* Practical familiarity with AI coding tools or a demonstrated willingness to adopt them, along with the ability to validate generated code critically.
* Strong ownership, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias toward finishing and shipping work.
* The ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, ask useful questions, and take feedback constructively.
* Evidence of practical engineering ability through projects, internships, research, open-source contributions, or other work demonstrating problem-solving and implementation skills.

**Strong Plus**

* **B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program.**
* Experience building and deploying software that solves a real problem for actual users.
* Experience diagnosing performance issues, improving reliability, or resolving difficult technical bugs.
* Exposure to production systems, cloud environments, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, or incident investigation.
* Experience working across multiple technical domains or adapting to unfamiliar technology stacks.
* Projects involving AI-powered applications, LLMs, autonomous agents, or workflow automation.
* Practical experience using AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining strong quality standards.
* Contributions to products, tools, research, or open-source projects that demonstrate initiative beyond completing tutorials.
* Evidence of independently taking an idea from initial problem discovery to a working, tested solution.

**How You'll Be Evaluated**

* **Engineering and project review:**
  Walk us through something you've built, the problem it solves, your personal contribution, and the decisions you made.
* **Practical problem-solving:**
  Work through an engineering problem that assesses reasoning, implementation, edge cases, and correctness rather than familiarity with a particular technology.
* **Code implementation and debugging:**
  Build or modify a solution in a practical environment, investigate failures, and demonstrate how you test your work.
* **System design and reasoning:**
  Approach an open-ended problem, explain the major components, evaluate trade-offs, and reason about reliability and future growth.
* **AI-assisted engineering exercise:**
  Use an AI agent to explore, build, or debug a solution while demonstrating how you guide, inspect, and verify its work.
* **Ownership and learning discussion:**
  Discuss a difficult problem you've solved, a mistake you've made, how you handled feedback, and how you approach unfamiliar technology.

**Why Join**

* Own meaningful engineering problems and contribute directly to product outcomes.
* Work across different technical domains rather than being restricted to a single technology stack.
* Learn how production systems are designed, built, deployed, monitored, and scaled.
* Use AI coding agents and modern engineering workflows to solve real-world problems.
* Develop strong engineering judgment through practical challenges, code reviews, and production ownership.
* Work in an environment that values initiative, learning speed, technical depth, and measurable impact.

**We value engineering ability over technology-stack familiarity, demonstrated problem-solving over memorized answers, and the ability to learn and deliver over experience with a specific tool.**

**Apply Now!**

**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.

title: Nutanix Automation Engineer
description:
**Details:**
 The Nutanix Automation Engineer exists to create leverage. Migration at scale and ongoing platform operations both generate large volumes of repetitive, error\-prone manual work \- pre\-migration checks, bulk VM configuration, post\-cutover validation, health reporting, provisioning, and configuration drift correction. This role converts that work into scripted, API\-driven, version\-controlled automation so the migration team moves faster with fewer defects and the support team absorbs more estate without adding heads. The role is measured in hours removed and errors prevented, not in scripts written.
   

  

**Migration Automation**
* Automate pre\-migration discovery and readiness checks \- bulk inventory extraction, snapshot and VMware Tools state validation, disk and configuration compatibility screening, and blocker reporting per wave.
* Script bulk operations against Nutanix Move and the Nutanix APIs \- migration plan creation, batch VM addition, replication status polling, and progress and exception reporting to the Project Manager.
* Build post\-migration validation automation: guest reachability, service and port checks, VirtIO and driver state, disk presence, backup re\-registration, and monitoring agent check\-in \- producing a pass/fail evidence artifact per VM that supports application owner sign\-off.
* Automate post\-cutover configuration \- categories and tags, protection policy assignment, affinity rules, and resource right\-sizing recommendations based on measured utilization.


**Operational and Platform Automation**
* Develop scheduled health and compliance automation \- NCC result collection and parsing, cluster resiliency and capacity reporting, snapshot and replication compliance checks, and upgrade\-readiness assessment.
* Build self\-service and workflow automation for routine requests: VM provisioning from standard templates, resource changes, decommissioning, and access requests, with approval gates preserved.
* Implement event\-driven automation using Prism Central Playbooks (X\-Play) or equivalent \- automated triage, enrichment, and remediation for well\-understood recurring alerts.
* Integrate the Nutanix platform with the client's ITSM and CMDB \- automated ticket creation with contextual detail, asset and configuration item synchronization, and closure/status write\-back.
* Build operational reporting and dashboards \- capacity runway, migration progress, incident and change volume, and platform health trending \- for both client leadership and Stefanini governance.


**Engineering Practice and Code Quality**
* Manage all automation as code in the client's or Stefanini's version control system, with branching, peer review, and change history \- no untracked scripts on jump boxes.
* Apply infrastructure\-as\-code practice where appropriate \- Terraform Nutanix provider or Ansible collections for repeatable, declarative configuration of clusters, categories, networks, and VMs.
* Implement safe automation design: idempotency, dry\-run and reporting\-only modes, explicit confirmation for destructive operations, structured logging, and error handling that fails loudly rather than silently.
* Handle credentials and secrets correctly \- no embedded passwords or API keys; integrate with the client's approved secrets management and service account model, with least\-privilege scoping.
* Document every automation asset: purpose, prerequisites, parameters, expected output, failure modes, and rollback, so ownership can transfer without the original author.
* Contribute reusable, client\-agnostic automation assets back to the Stefanini Nutanix practice library, accelerating the next engagement.

title: Lead SDET
description:
**Role:** 

 Lead SDET (Quality \& Release)
 




**Location:** 

 Gurgaon, India (On\-site)
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-time
 




**Experience Required:** 

 5 – 7 years
 




  





  





**ABOUT** 





 Visitly is a visitor management platform used across 25\+ countries by enterprises with serious security requirements — Fortune 500 companies spanning technology, cybersecurity, hardware and transportation. When someone walks into one of their lobbies, our software is what stands between the front door and the building.
 




  





**WHY THIS ROLE IS INTERESTING** 





 Our failure modes are real ones. A badge that doesn’t print stalls in a lobby. A broken SSO integration locks out a customer’s entire security team. Tenant isolation has to hold absolutely, every time.
 





 And the surface we have to cover is genuinely hard: a Java/Spring Boot backend, an Angular web app, a React Native mobile app, an iPad kiosk, physical badge printers and badge readers, 50\+ third\-party integrations, and multi\-tenant architecture underneath all of it.
 





 Testing everything isn’t an option. Deciding what matters most, and being right about it, is the job.
 




  





**WHAT YOU’LL OWN** 



* Quality strategy — build the risk model for our product: which flows must never break, what depth of coverage each one deserves, and where automation earns its maintenance cost
* The automation layer — shape our test architecture at the right levels, integrated into CI, fast enough that engineers rely on it rather than route around it
* Release management — own the release gate, go/no\-go, staged rollout, and rollback. You’ll have real authority here and the backing to use it
* The team — lead and grow a small QA team, hands\-on alongside them
* Production feedback — close the loop between what happens in the field and what we test, including the observability that makes debugging fast


- 


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** 



* 5–7 years in software quality, with meaningful time at a product company — somewhere you shipped your own software to your own customers and lived with the consequences
* You write code. Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript — the language matters less than the fact that you build tools rather than only use them
* You’ve built or substantially rebuilt an automation framework and put it into CI, and can explain the trade\-offs you made
* You’ve owned or co\-owned a release process, and you’ve been in a production incident
* You have opinions about testing that you can argue for — and that you’ve changed at least once





 ﻿
 





**Bonus:** 

 hardware or device matrices, multi\-tenant SaaS, SSO/SAML/SCIM, mobile or kiosk testing.
 




  





**WHO THIS ISN’T FOR** 





 We’ll be direct, because it saves us both time.
 





 This isn’t a role where you bring the process that worked at your last company and install it here. Our constraints are different — smaller team, faster cycles, stranger test surface, higher stakes per defect. A playbook built for a twenty\-person QA org and a two\-week regression cycle won’t survive contact with how we work.
 





 It’s also not a role for a pure QA management profile. If your experience is running testing as a separate function or a services engagement — headcount, test case volume, defect throughput — this will be a poor fit in both directions.
 




  






 We care much less about test case counts, certifications, or deep expertise in one specific tool. We care much more about how you decide what’s worth testing when you can’t test everything, what you do when there’s no spec and the person who built the feature has moved on, and whether you can change your mind when the evidence changes.
 




  





  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Full ownership of a function, built from the ground up, with a direct line to leadership
* Meaningful equity in a profitable, growing company
* A hard technical problem, with enterprise customers who hold us to a high bar
* No layers between you and the decisions
